prompt: Your savings DOUBLE every $7$ years. You have $\$2000$ today. In how many years will you have $\$16000$?
hint: First find how many times the money has to double to get from $2000$ dollars to $16000$ dollars.

hints.text: First find how many times the money has to double to get from $2000$ dollars to $16000$ dollars.
The money must grow by a factor of $16000 \div 2000 = 8$, and $8 = 2^3$, so that is $3$ doublings. Each doubling takes $7$ years.
Three doublings at $7$ years each take $3 \times 7 = 21$ years.

explanation: Compare the two amounts to find the growth needed: $16000 \div 2000 = 8$.
Each doubling multiplies by $2$, so solve $2^n = 8$ to get $n = 3$ doublings.
Each doubling takes $7$ years, so the wait is $3 \times 7 = 21$ years.

alternativeExplanations.title: Walk the years
steps: You land on it at year $21$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Use the formula
steps: With doubling time $7$, the rule is $A = 2000 \cdot 2^{t/7}$.
